not_proven_online.untrusted_peer_spoof: The loopback socket peer is always trusted in this harness, so the 'untrusted peer ignores X-Forwarded-For' path is proven only by unit test (login-client-ip.test.ts), not by a live request from a non-trusted source address.
not_proven_online.public_tunnel_hostname: cloudflared is running under the root account with a token file; its ingress config is not readable from this session, so the rehearsal used 127.0.0.1:4008 with the same trusted-peer + X-Forwarded-For shape rather than the public hostname.
